=======================================

Regarding the update on January 24th, 2019

There was an error in title update Ver. 1.19 for the Steam version of "DYNASTY WARRIORS 9".

 - Added new wallpaper.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused to our customers.

=========================================
Oct 23, 2018

Announcement regarding Oct 23 update 

There has been an issue with the latest Dynasty Warriors 9 update. 
Ver. 1.14 has been rolled back to prevent further conflicts. 
To play the game, please restart your Steam Client and reinstall Update Ver. 1.13. 

We apologize for any inconvenience.

notes.title: Update information 01.12 (08/09/2018)
notes.notes:
- Added BGM from a previous title from the DYNASTY WARRIORS series.
- Added a function to the furniture type "Musical Instrument" that allows players to change the BGM for the field or battlefield.
- Added a feature that allows players to sort "Weapons", "Gems", "Accessories", and "Horses".
- Added the item "Portable Bonfire Set".
- Players can now select from among multiple locations when fast traveling to towns or castles.
- Added a setting to "Options" that allows players to select whether they want the cut scenes for siege weapons to be played.
- Made improvements to some conversation events.
- Made improvements to the behavior of officers during battle.
- Added a new Ordeal.
- Added a feature that allows players to equip bows, and also added several new bows.
- Improved the functionality of shooting arrows.
- Corrected a number of other minor issues.

To use the sorting feature, please perform either of the procedures below.

Procedure 1: From your Steam client's "Controller Settings", select "BROWSE CONFIGS" - "Recommended", and then select "APPLY CONFIGURATION".
Procedure 2: From your Steam client's "Controller Settings", select "Pause Screen", and then set "Sort" to any button.

notes.title: Update information 01.11 (07/03/2018)
notes.notes:
- Added new features to "Photo Mode".
- Improved the movement of archers.
- Corrected an issue in which the NPC from which you would normally accept the Wei Chapter 4 Mission "Procuring Supplies - Dingtao" would not appear.
- Corrected an issue in which the Wei Chapter 5 Mission "Negotiating with the Villagers" could not be accepted.
- Corrected an issue in which the Wei Chapter 6 Mission "Gathering Enemy Intelligence" could not be completed.
- Corrected an issue in which the Nanzhong Chapter 10 Mission "Capture Yuexi" could not be completed.
- Corrected an issue in which cavalry would rarely fall from their horses unnaturally.
- Now, when local save data does not exist, data will be downloaded from the cloud upon starting the game.
- Corrected a number of other minor issues.

- Corrected an issue that prevented the Shu Chapter 7 Mission "Assault on Mianzhu" from being completed normally.
- Corrected an issue in which some events of the Jin Chapter 12 Mission "Persuading the Qiang Troops to Defect" would not occur.
- Corrected a number of other minor issues.

notes.title: Update information 01.09 (05/31/2018)

- Corrected an issue in which siege towers would not move during the Wu Chapter 10 Mission “Ambush at Yiling".
- Corrected an issue in which, after meeting the victory conditions for the Jin Chapter 13 Mission "Assault on Chengdu", other missions could incorrectly be accepted.
- Corrected an issue in which the Shu Chapter 12 Mission "Battle of Mt. Tielong" could not be completed if Xiahou Ba had been slain.
- Improved the behavior for controlling the camera by using a mouse.
- Corrected a number of other minor issues.

notes.title: Update information 01.08 (05/17/2018)

- Corrected an issue in which the Chapter 2 Mission "Defeat Dong Bai" could sometimes not be completed.

- Corrected a number of other minor issues.

notes.title: Update information 01.07 (04/27/2018)
notes.notes:
- Added the difficulty setting "Ultimate".
- Added a new mission "The Arena".
- Added new accessories.
- Added a feature to "Options" that allows you reset the level of officers.
- Eased the conditions for obtaining "The Book of Musou".
- Added a feature that allows you to exchange "The Book of Musou" items for "Upgrade Points".
- Added new features to "Photo Mode".
- " Merchants" that allow you to purchase items after capturing important bases will now appear.
- You can now sell horses even if other officers are mounting them.
- Corrected an issue in which allied officers would rarely appear at enemy bases.
- Corrected an issue in which the destination guide would rarely not be displayed correctly.
- Corrected an issue in which the game would stop when playing the game by using Remote Desktop.
Note: Remote Desktop can only be used if your display mode is set to "Borderless" or "Windowed".
- Corrected a number of other minor issues.

notes.title: Update information 01.06 (04/18/2018)
notes.notes: - Corrected an issue in which the game would stop after collecting certain gems if the game's language was set to German.

- Corrected an issue in which, when starting Free Mode without having played the Story Mode, the default weapons of officers would disappear.
- Corrected an issue in which the screen would become dark when viewing events and movies from the Gallery.
- Corrected an issue in which the player would become buried in the ground after completing the Chapter 7 Mission "Liu Bei's Escape".
- Added support for displaying the languages below.
  Japanese
  Chinese (Traditional Chinese)
  Chinese (Simplified Chinese)
- Added support for voice for the language below.
  Chinese (Simplified Chinese)
- Corrected a number of other minor issues.

notes.title: Update information 01.03 (03/16/2018)
notes.notes:
- The maximum values for "Attack", "Defense", and "Health" have been raised.
- Certain enemies will now drop the item "The Book of Musou" on the difficulty level "Chaos".
- Added a feature that allows you to reset your Upgrade Points by using "The Book of Musou".
- Added a feature that allows you to set whether you want to view "Officer Encounter Scenes".
- Changed the order in which "Accessories" and "Gems" are sorted.
- You can now select your attack target even when the "Counter Assist" option is set to "On".
- Improved the movements of  armies.
- Corrected an issue in which enemy soldiers would appear from some allied bases.
- Corrected an issue in which items would not be dropped.
- Corrected an issue in which Chapter 2 - "Invitation to a Scenic Spot" could sometimes not be completed.
- Corrected an issue in which, after completing Chapter 5 - "Battle of Xinye", the route was not displayed correctly.
- Corrected an issue in which Chapter 8 - "Break Through Hanzhong" could sometimes not be completed.
- Corrected an issue in which the marker indicating that a new item has been obtained was sometimes not displayed when collecting "Accessories" and "Gems".
- Corrected an issue in which reinforcements would not appear as a result of the order missions were completed in.
- The method in which you operate menus can now be changed from the option "Key/Mouse Controls".
- Added support for "2880 × 1620" and "3200 × 1800" resolutions.
- Corrected an issue in which the display of rain was difficult to see.
- Corrected a number of other minor issues.
